# typescript-eslint 8.72.1 `no-unused-vars` test cases from #12923, each as the
# only code of a `<script setup lang="ts">` SFC.
# `typescript-eslint`: its reports on default options (no ignore patterns).
# vize matches them when varsIgnorePattern and argsIgnorePattern are "",
# except where `kept` gives the reason. `vize`: reports on vize defaults (`^_`).
